tools.title: Buy domain
tools.description: Executes a single-domain registration previously quoted by get_purchase_quote (product:domain); this tool rejects calls without a valid quote. The quote is presented to the user for explicit approval, then this tool is called with confirm:true, the quote's idempotencyKey, the expectedPrice and years from the quote, and the full registrant contact supplied by the user. The purchase is charged immediately and is non-refundable. Vercel stores no reusable registrant profile, so contact details are required each time. The quote returns disclosures the user must see before approving: the payment method (default card on file), that taxes/fees may apply on top of the price, the item terms (non-refundable), and, when auto-renew is on, the recurring-charge terms in disclosures.subscription (renews automatically each term at the then-current price until auto-renew is turned off), plus a full-terms link.
